_what: Hearing a call one audio source at a time (computer/hearing-sources.mjs). Each source (the microphone, the sound the Mac plays) is heard on its own and never mixed with another before it is heard, so who said what does not need a mixer to guess. A source row says what its words are called when nobody can be told apart inside it (`speaker`), and whether it is the person's own voice (`me`). `session_file` is where each session's record is kept: which hearing program heard it, the flags that applied (for example whether a relay or a training opt-out was asked for), when and which sources. Providers are rows too: the first `hearing` row in computer-sources.json whose program is here is used unless `provider` names one.

words.needs_sources: Give sources: [{ source, path }], each a recording of one source.
words.no_hearing: This Mac has no program that hears recordings.
